purpose: baseline local ranking and modal derivative sources, not finite-delta target prediction

domain.grid: one fixed finite saved-time grid; no alignment or grid relocation with zeta
domain.model: fixed linear modal elastic reference with constant B and omega
domain.baseline_peak: P0>0 and resolved above force-error scale for normalized metric

exact_directional_derivative.active_A: indices n with abs(V0_n)=P0 exactly in the defined finite-grid model
exact_directional_derivative.left_peak_derivative: min_{n in A}g_n, not the rule for positive-increment ranking
exact_directional_derivative.right_controlling_B: argmax_{n in A}g_n; all tied maximizers retained
exact_directional_derivative.proof: Inactive finite branches have a positive baseline gap; active branch expansions yield the right-hand maximum derivative.
exact_directional_derivative.zero_baseline: If P0=0, right force-peak derivative=max_n(abs(Vzeta_n)); normalized improvement metric undefined.

engineering_units.S: -Pprime_right/P0, numerical peak-reduction percent per damping percentage point
engineering_units.D_percent: 100*(1-P(zeta0+delta)/P0)=S*b+o(b) as b decreases to0 from right
engineering_units.no_extra_100: Do not multiply S by100 a second time.
engineering_units.finite3pp: 3*S is only a local first-order reading, not a guaranteed5%-to8% improvement.

modal_sources_at_each_right_controller.closure: sum_r(a_r_n)=Pprime_right/P0 for every n in B
modal_sources_at_each_right_controller.a_positive: opposes decrease or increases local peak
modal_sources_at_each_right_controller.presentation: For each controller separately show baseline |a|-ranked leading modes or predefined groups plus all remaining modes. Do not silently reuse old independent-amplitude rankings as derivative rankings.
modal_sources_at_each_right_controller.multiple_controllers: Retain separate times/source vectors; no cross-time mixing or average claimed as unique modal force split.
modal_sources_at_each_right_controller.noncontrolling_active_peak: its modal sum equals its branch derivative, not necessarily the true right peak derivative
modal_sources_at_each_right_controller.not_actual_force: This is a baseline derivative decomposition, not actual target FNA/modal shear shares.

near_ties_and_uncertainty.near_set: abs(V0_n)>=P0-force_tolerance, recorded separately from exact A
near_ties_and_uncertainty.derivative_tolerance: record separately if using a numerical near-max derivative set; do not call it exact B
near_ties_and_uncertainty.near_inactive_peaks: keep gap and g_n because a small finite increment may switch branches
near_ties_and_uncertainty.superset_note: If exact A is contained in the near set and branch derivatives are exact, max over near set is an upper bound on the exact right derivative, not an equality.
near_ties_and_uncertainty.finite_precision: computed states/derivatives require their own numerical status before strict differentiation claims
near_ties_and_uncertainty.sign: Active sign is nonzero when P0>0; subsequent sign changes/derivative variation require finite-increment analysis.
near_ties_and_uncertainty.global_sign: Flipping both baseline response and derivative globally leaves g,S and modal a unchanged.

engineering_reading_six_steps: find exact active peaks and right-controlling branches
list signed mode contributions at each controller separately
rank layers per input and flag near ties; predefined minimum across inputs is only a local screening summary
connect candidates6/7/8/10 to allowed-delta checks and full-window prediction/error intervals, preserving three independent statuses

ranking.S_zero: no first-order conclusion; higher order may matter
ranking.S_negative: for sufficiently small positive delta peak increases
ranking.across_inputs: retain each input; any minimum or aggregation rule predefined, not universal earthquake bound
